summary: Longevity Health Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a settlement agreement with Puritan Partners LLC, resolving litigation over a defaulted 2022 convertible note and warrant. Puritan exchanged the existing $1.25M note and a warrant for two new senior secured convertible notes totaling $2.35M, with first-priority liens on substantially all assets of the company and subsidiaries, including pledged equity and IP. The filing also notes subsidiary guarantees and amended security agreements. This is a debt restructuring and litigation settlement, not a standard special-situation event; watch for covenant compliance and potential dilution.
